newsitem.title: UK: GLOF-FULKE CLAIMS SECOND ACE IN A WEEK.
newsitem.headline: GLOF-FULKE CLAIMS SECOND ACE IN A WEEK.

text.p: Pierre Fulke of Sweden scored a hole-in-one at the 14th at Royal Troon in the British Open on Thursday -- a week after achieving the same feat in the Loch Lomond World Invitational.
Fulke, playing late in the evening, holed a three iron at the 179-yard hole on his way to a two-over-par 73.
In the first round at Loch Lomond last week he aced the eighth hole.
The Swede now has four aces in his professional career.
